name: esp32_oled_096
title: ESP32 with a 0.96-inch OLED
description: An ESP32 board with a 128x64 SSD1306 OLED on I2C, yellow on the top rows and blue below: a CP2102 USB bridge on micro-USB, EN and Boot buttons, no LEDs
notes: Sold by many makers with no name on the board, so no maker is written and no schematic was read. The module says ESP-32 and no more.
GPIO 4 and 5 carry the I2C of the OLED and come out on the header too.

oled.notes: Two colours: rows 0 to 15 of the controller are yellow, the rest blue, with a dark strip of 0.2 mm between them. It answered with no reset driven; whether its RES reaches a GPIO is not known.

power.name: 5V
power.why: From the micro-USB, or from the contacts 5V.

power.name: 3V3
power.why: On the contacts 3V3, written 3V on the short row.

svp_side.type: 2.54 mm holes, 10, from the antenna end

svn_side.type: 2.54 mm holes, 16, from the antenna end

front.source: a photo by Anton of his board, 2026-11-06

back.source: a photo by Anton of his board, 2026-11-06

photo.source: a photo by Anton of his board, 2026-11-06
photo.notes: The silkscreen, from the antenna end: SVP 25 26 S1 CM S0 CL 3V GND 5V on one side, SVN 16 5 4 0 2 14 12 13 15 RX TX 3V3 GND GND 5V on the other; S1, CM, S0 and CL are the flash lines SD1, CMD, SD0 and CLK. SILABS CP2102 on the back, a micro-USB, buttons EN and Boot.

bench.by: Anton, by eye, and the logs
bench.notes: An I2C scan of every pair of the output pins at 0x3C and 0x3D found one device, 0x3C on SDA 5 and SCL 4, with no reset driven. DGX 0.10.12 with SSD1306_128X64 filled rows 0 to 15, which are yellow, and drew a line on row 16 and a frame below, which are blue.

chip.source: esptool on Anton's board: ESP32-D0WD-V3 rev 3.1, 4 MB flash of maker 0x68; the port is a CP2102, USB 10c4:ea60

leds.notes: No LED on the board: nothing lights, and none is seen on either side.

size.notes: The lit area of 128x64 is 22 x 11.2 mm, the strip of 0.2 mm between the colours in it.
